items.title: GPT-4 API general availability and deprecation of older models in the Completions API
items.summary: GPT-3.5 Turbo, DALL·E and Whisper APIs are also generally available, and we are releasing a deprecation plan for older models of the Completions API, which will retire at the beginning of 2024.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI宣布GPT-4 API全面可用，同时GPT-3.5 Turbo、DALL·E和Whisper API也已全面开放。此外，公司发布了旧版Completions API的退役计划，旨在推动开发者迁移至更先进的模型接口。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI API的重大更新与旧模型退役计划，对开发者生态有直接影响。
